info.run: Arkansas Commissioner of State Lands (online post-auction sales)
info.schedule: Continuous: parcels the county auction did not sell are listed online and each parcel's auction starts with its first bid
info.note: Starting bids are the taxes, penalties and costs owed. The Commissioner also holds one live auction per county each year; those catalogs are posted at cosl.org.
